verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents a feedback portal with a public roadmap and automatic notification of users when their requests ship, so it ties feedback to roadmap status and delivery. It never explicitly documents linking requests to discrete roadmap features, initiatives, or release/changelog entries. Missing for 10: explicit request-to-feature linking, initiatives support, request-to-release/changelog linking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can link feedback requests to roadmap features, initiatives, and releases

citations.quote: Centralize insights to a single source of truth with a feedback portal, in-app widgets, and integrations. Let users vote on each other's ideas & show a public roadmap.
Featurebase automatically notifies all relevant users when their requests are shipped.
